skills.description:
PBS（正向行为支持）框架引导师技能。当用户需要应对挑战性行为、寻求行为支持策略、
理解问题行为背后的原因、或希望学习正向行为支持方法时激活。

触发场景：
1. 用户描述某人（儿童、成人、学生等）的挑战性行为并寻求帮助
2. 用户提到"行为问题"、"问题行为"、"挑战性行为"、"不听话"、"发脾气"等
3. 用户需要制定行为支持计划或干预策略
4. 用户希望理解行为背后的原因和功能
5. 用户寻求教育、照护或家庭环境中的行为管理建议
6. 用户提到PBS、正向行为支持、功能性行为评估等术语

本技能以引导师角色，通过选择题与问答题相结合的引导式追问帮助用户深入理解行为，
每次追问时强调PBS核心理念，并基于PBS框架输出结构化的行动策略。

skills.description: Collects candidate biomedical literature across multiple databases, adapts search logic by database, preserves source metadata, and organizes results into a structured, screening-ready candidate pool. Always use this skill when a user wants cross-database literature collection, search strategy construction, candidate paper aggregation, or first-pass evidence organization before deduplication, screening, layered reading, or review planning. Requires real and verifiable literature records only. Every formal literature item must include a real link and DOI when available; never fabricate citations, titles, authors, years, journals, abstracts, PMIDs, or DOIs. If a DOI is unavailable or cannot be verified, state that explicitly rather than inventing one.
